attchmntText: Shiv Aum Steels Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 68002000 equity shares of Rs. 2 each.
voiceSummary: Shiv Aum Steels Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board proposed subdividing existing equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 into five shares each with a face value of Rs. 2, subject to member approval. This split will alter the Memorandum of Association to reflect a total share capital of Rs. 15,00,00,000 divided into 7,50,00,000 equity shares. M Rupareliya & Associates was appointed as the scrutinizer for the voting process. The trading window for designated persons remains closed for 48 hours after the announcement. The company reported a net profit of Rs. 344.08 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
